Tune a mover or all movers of an iTRAK
5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0, Tuning mover logic moved from Device Handler to AOI. ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- The instruction downloads tuning parameters for one or all of the CIP mover axes.
Instruction Execution: ----- Level
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1002 Device Handler faulted 1003 Device Handler is not in state Available 1010 Cfg_MoverID out of bounds. Select a value -1 <= Cfg_MoverID < number of active movers 1011 Set_PositionBandwidth out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1012 Set_PositionIntegratorBandwidth out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1013 Set_PositionIntegratorHold out of bounds. Select a value 0 <= Set_PositionIntegratorHold < 1 1014 Set_VelocityBandwidth out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1015 Set_VelocityIntegratorBandwidth out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1016 Set_VelocityIntegratorHold out of bounds. Select a value 0 <= Set_VelocityIntegratorHold < 1 1017 Set_VelocityFeedforward out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1018 Set_AccelerationFeedforward out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1019 Set_PositionErrorTolerance out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1020 Set_VelocityErrorTolerance out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1021 Set_TorqueLowPassFilterBandwidth out of bounds, input cannot be negative 1022 Set_LoadObserver out of bounds 1023 Set_LoadObserverBandwidth out of bounds (checked only if Load Observer is enabled) 1024 Set_LoadObserverIntegratorBandwidth out of bounds (checked only if Load Observer is enabled) 1025 Set_AdaptiveTuningConfiguration out of bounds 1026 Set_NotchFilterFrequency[] member out of bounds, a notch filter configuration is invalid 1027 Set_CommandNotchFilterFrequency[] member out of bounds, a command notch filter configuration is invalid 1028 Set_SystemInertia value out of bounds, value cannot be <=0 1050 Command timeout
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0, Tuning mover logic moved from Device Handler to AOI. 4.0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. Support for iTRAK57xx Device Handler 4.0 1.1 - Added Notch filter tuning. Event fields match Machine Builder standards order 1.0 - First Release
